messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-06-27] standup/cinder/2025-06-27: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.
- [2026-03-20] standup/atlas/2026-03-20: Priya runs the quarterly capacity review.
- [2025-01-29] standup/ember/2025-01-29: The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-04-02] standup/ember/2025-04-02: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2: Observation from the Boreal team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent. The Boreal team runs its planning on Thursdays.
- [2026-04-03] standup/cinder/2026-04-03: Cinder runs its planning on Mondays.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-06-09] handover/2025-06-09-billing-api: The Ember team handed billing-api to Boreal today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Lena Fischer.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-07-29] standup/ember/2025-07-29: Policy: every auth-gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-07-21] standup/ember/2025-07-21: Ember runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-03] standup/atlas/2025-04-03: Reminder from team Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01: Heads-up from Boreal: the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-10-24] standup/cinder/2025-10-24: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: The Atlas team this year is Priya Raman and Tomasz.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
